title: Renewal, Non-Renewal Notice, Escalation and Early Cancellation Terms — Building Automation Service Plans

# Renewal, Non-Renewal Notice, Escalation and Early Cancellation Terms — Building Automation Service Plans

**Term 1.** Each tier of the Building Automation Service Plans states whether the plan renews automatically at term end, the number of calendar days before term end at which the renewal window opens, the number of calendar days before term end by which a non-renewal notice must be received, the escalation applied to the annual plan fee at each renewal, the calendar days of written notice before a cancellation takes effect, and the fee, as a percentage of the unbilled remainder of the term, when the plan is cancelled early.

| Tier | Renews automatically | Renewal window opens (calendar days before term end) | Non-renewal notice by (calendar days before term end) | Escalation at renewal (percent) | Cancellation notice (calendar days) | Early cancellation fee (percent of unbilled remainder) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | yes | 45 | 30 | 5.0 | 30 | 25 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | yes | 60 | 30 | 4.5 | 30 | 30 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | yes | 60 | 60 | 4.0 | 60 | 30 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | yes | 90 | 60 | 3.5 | 60 | 35 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | yes | 90 | 90 | 3.5 | 90 | 40 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | no | 120 | 90 | 3.0 | 120 | 50 |

**Term 2.** The Integrated Building Automation Partnership is the one tier that does not renew automatically.

**Term 3 (illustrative reading).** A Remote Optimization Plan whose term ends on a given day opens its renewal window 90 days before that day, needs any non-renewal notice received 90 days before it, and at renewal carries its annual plan fee escalated by 3.5 percent. Cancelled early, it needs 90 days of written notice and carries 40 percent of the unbilled remainder of the term.
